label: mcl_core_log_spruce_top
reference_prompt: Create a close visual reference for the cut end-grain of a mature spruce trunk from a cold grounded dark-fantasy forest. Show many fine growth rings recording short summers and long winters, with pale muted sapwood surrounding warmer resinous heartwood. The fibers are straight and compact, interrupted by small knots, slight radial checking and subtle amber resin staining. Avoid broad oak rings, dramatic dark heartwood, perfect concentric targets, polished lumber or glossy fresh sap. The cross-section should feel lightweight compared with oak yet tightly grown by climate. Establish a believable cold-grown conifer end-grain language without dictating the source texture's geometry.
